kicker: Site visit book, buyer nahi aaya
title: Site visit fix tha. Buyer *aaya hi nahi*.
fix_label: Visit se 3 ghante pehle ye bhejo 👇
message:
Namaste [naam] ji, aaj *[time]* site visit hai.
📍 Location: [map link]
Gate pe [executive naam] milenge: [number]
Plan change ho to bas "2" reply karo, naya time de denge.
why: location + *ek naam aur number* = commitment. "2" reply se reschedule aasaan, ghost nahi.
caption:
Site visit ka no-show sabse mehenga lead loss hai: executive ka time, petrol, aur buyer competitor ke paas. 🏢

Visit se 3 ghante pehle reminder:
✅ Time
✅ Map link
✅ Kaun milega + number
✅ "2" = reschedule

Jo reschedule karta hai woh buyer hai. Jo ghost karta hai woh reminder ke bina karta.

Save karo 🔖

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.
